Opening markets for industrial manufacturers

Connecting market strategy with the practical work of entering a country.

The objective

Help US and European manufacturers of industrial quality-control tools enter India and Southeast Asia.

Mak’s contribution

Across several assignments, Mak led market-entry strategy, product positioning and pricing, channel development, distributor set-up and sales campaigns. His work also covered certifications, regulatory approvals and commercial contracts. He established sourcing of product accessories from Indian manufacturers for the same businesses.

The outcome

The assignments opened overseas markets and established sourcing arrangements in India.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Connecting customer development, local partners, commercial arrangements and supply capabilities across borders.

Related services

  • Reach customers in India
  • Qualify and develop suppliers
  • Grow your market presence
  • Find and develop suitable partnerships
